name: Ava Loveless
source:
Fictional short story set in the United Kingdom under a Gothic/Steampunk aesthetic, where a young woman contemplates a discovery that could potentially change the world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4513900/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一篇發生在英國的虛構短篇故事，融合了哥德與蒸汽龐克美學。一位年輕女子正思索著一項可能改變整個世界的發現。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4513900/]Steam[/url]］
